statement: Current verification supports material Tier-1 changes: 都一處 has explicit NT$280–420 one-person sets; Sugar Pea's official NT$300+10% minimum does not create a <=500 complete-meal path because current meal-scale dishes are >500 while sub-500 items are nibble/toast-scale; 驢子 requires each diner to order a Pasta/Risotto or Grill/Pan and is listed at NT$1,000–1,999; Wok by O'BOND is a seasonal tasting-menu restaurant; 孫麵店 has two complete NT$320 meal sets; 穆記 remains a plausible solo survivor with adequate-portion and peak-crowd signals.
locator: See source bundle roles and individual URLs
notes: These observations support the semantic deltas, not every one of the 314 heuristic Tier-1 signals. The full ledger preserves reversible screen-out status where exact price-floor proof is absent.
